verdict.rationale: Codex CLI ships a `/plugins` browser command and a `codex plugin marketplace add` mechanism, backed by a real curated marketplace.json catalog (openai-curated) listing plugins with install/auth policies, and GitHub's openai/plugins repo lists discoverable entries (figma, ios, web-apps, notion, expo) plus named skills like $linear via $skill-installer. A probe confirmed the catalog is fetchable and installable pre-install. missing for 10: no ratings/leaderboard or popularity signals, no independent hands-on review of the browsing/search UX itself.
